items.helpvalue:
The basic idea is that a string of characters defines in which order the elements should be displayed., and any sub group you might want to make and possibly style differently,
here we will use an array to form the items and order
add an element, pick its type, if you need to change the order, you can drag/drop to move them. you can delete any item by pressing its -(minus sign) button
